answer_to_meeting_format_question: Yes. This packet is the controlling instruction for how to hold the council. meeting_protocol.name: facilitator preflight
procedure: verify exact commit and doctrine generations
verify all required sources are readable
record missing evidence
confirm Workspace 32/32 and Control Room 94/94 or record changed evidence
confirm no proposal is represented as approved

meeting_protocol.name: sealed independent reviews
procedure: each reviewer works without seeing another review
each reviews all nine forks through its assigned primary lens and every critical rubric dimension
each submits the uniform review form
facilitator locks the three outputs before disclosure

meeting_protocol.name: evidence normalization
procedure: facilitator extracts agreements, disagreements, missing evidence, and source contradictions
no reviewer changes a position during normalization
facts are cited to exact source and claim label

meeting_protocol.name: fork rounds
procedure: review PROP-001 through PROP-009 in order
lead reviewer is the seat whose lens is most material
other seats challenge once each
facilitator records proposed disposition, contract changes, safe interim default, and dissent

meeting_protocol.name: cross-roadmap contradiction sweep
procedure: test every candidate disposition against all three roadmaps and the Production Maturity Baseline
check terminology, roles, states, authority, data, timelines, costs, platform order, hardware, Hermes, human-workspace scaling, and adoption gates
do not repair one roadmap while leaving another contradictory

meeting_protocol.name: program and evidence gate review
procedure: separate current verified state from approved design, proposed design, and future evidence
confirm Phase 0 exit evidence
confirm Phase 1 entry order
preserve elapsed observation windows and human acceptance gates
meeting_protocol.exit: ordered work packages and gate ledger

meeting_protocol.name: dissent and compression round
procedure: each reviewer states the strongest remaining objection in no more than three items
each states what evidence would change its view
facilitator preserves minority positions and removes duplicate prose without deleting disagreement

meeting_protocol.name: non-voting synthesis
procedure: facilitator fills the disposition ledger template
validate every required field
produce roadmap amendments, contradiction results, open gates, and one Joe approval card
do not invent consensus or decide for Joe

facilitation_rules: Independent reviews remain sealed until all three are complete.
The facilitator is not a fourth vote and cannot silently add a preferred architecture.
A majority does not override a substantiated critical security, authority, source-truth, release, restore, or evidence objection.
No reviewer may cite another review as primary evidence; cite the underlying source.
Absence of evidence is Unknown, not Healthy, approved, complete, or zero.
A proposal may be accepted only with exact downstream contract and roadmap changes.
A deferral requires owner, reopen trigger, safe interim default, and blocked scope.
Dissent is preserved in the final ledger even when Joe later chooses another path.
Cost and ROI forecasts remain hypotheses until measured against the five approved baselines.
The final output recommends; Joe approves.
known_open_evidence: Joe's five uncoached Workspace journeys are not performed.
Joe's six uncoached Control Room flows are not performed.
The five operating baselines remain unknown pending instrumentation or interview.
Responsive, keyboard, screen-reader, sterile-mode, and Color Assist evidence is incomplete.
Workspace and Control Room each retain the known duplicate ordinal-2 metadata defect under system loop 315; it is not represented as repaired.
The doctrine Markdown cutoff remains a separate NO-GO until its evidence, consumer, deployment, and Joe-approval gates pass.
Hermes R0 is only a proposed constrained evaluation; live data, scheduling, delivery, durable request creation, dispatch, mutation, and external effects remain separately gated.
A final independent platform name has not been selected.
Mac mini purchase and activation remain separate evidence-gated decisions.

independent_reviewer: You are one of three independent members of the CARR roadmap council. Do not ask for or read another member's review until your sealed review is complete.
Read phase0/council-launch-packet-2026-08-12.v1.json first, then every canonical and repo source it requires at the exact versions declared.
Your assigned seat and primary lens are provided separately. Apply that lens deeply, but also evaluate every critical rubric dimension and all nine PROP forks.
Label every claim current_verified, implemented_not_deployed, approved_design, proposed_for_council, future_evidence_gate, or unknown.
Return exactly the uniform_independent_review_form defined by the packet. Cite underlying sources, preserve uncertainty, and do not represent council proposals as approved.
The council is advisory. Do not authorize construction, deployment, commercial rollout, purchase, or roadmap amendment.
synthesis_facilitator: You are the non-voting facilitator for the CARR roadmap council.
Verify all three independent reviews were completed and sealed before cross-disclosure. Read the frozen source packet yourself; reviewer summaries are not source evidence.
Normalize agreements, disagreements, missing evidence, and contradictions, then run PROP-001 through PROP-009 in order using the meeting protocol.
Do not use simple majority to erase a substantiated critical objection. Resolve it, modify the proposal, or defer it with an owner, reopen trigger, safe interim default, and blocked scope.
Fill phase0/council-disposition-ledger-template.v1.json completely. Preserve dissent. Separate current state, approved design, proposed design, future gates, and Unknown.

End with one concise Joe approval card listing recommendations, modifications, deferrals, blocked scopes, Phase 0 exit evidence, and the exact first Phase 1 work packages. The council recommends; Joe approves.
